materialChanges: Corrected ATTRIBUTION.md from version 0.1.1 to 0.2.0 and distinguished the frozen candidate from review and adjudication artifacts added later.
Added reviewed cross-lesson alignments for scientific model, model variable, and model domain, and mapped the clinical wrap-up scene to the nine core glossary terms it uses.

reviewDispositions.rationale: The independently checked 99.1 kPa base result, 101.1 kPa volume variation, and 100.8 kPa temperature variation agree with the final worked example; its unit, direction, and model-boundary interpretation remain correct.
The assessment key retains correctly rounded predictions of 99.8, 105.0, and 95.0 kPa, an appropriate 0.2 kPa tolerance, and a bounded one-input sensitivity interpretation.

The final transfer item already distinguishes an unweighted point-sensor mean from a chamber-volume average, uses the spatial spread against the uniformity prediction, and makes the response depend on the requested output.

The clinical wrap-up remains an explicitly invented, non-clinical model-audit exercise. Within its stipulated positive-rate structure, recalibrating one shared rate cannot represent the unchanged response while preserving the earlier comparison.
ATTRIBUTION.md now identifies version 0.2.0 and states that the frozen candidate lacked review and adjudication artifacts, while the two reviews and this finalization were added subsequently.
The concrete two-vessel opening, prerequisite retrieval, and non-punitive recovery route were preserved unchanged because they already pass the first-read and learner-routing gate.
The complete pressure worked example and its self-explanation prompt were preserved unchanged because the reviewer found the selection, execution, checks, limits, and reflection coherent.
The competing-model misconception repair was preserved unchanged because it elicits a prediction, supplies discriminating evidence, reconstructs the bounded conclusion, and rechecks it.
The chamber transfer was preserved unchanged because it requires model selection and qualitative audit in a genuinely changed context without repeating the worked formula.

The scientific-model glossary entry now adopts PREM-WEL-001 explicitly and explains that this lesson applies the established purposeful-representation sense to scientific assumptions, domains, and failure tests.
The model-variable glossary entry now narrows PREM-SCI-003's general variable sense to a quantity explicitly represented in a model.
The model-domain glossary entry now declares a distinct sense from PREM-QNT-007's function domain and states that model domain also includes supported purposes, conditions, scales, and contexts.
The clinical wrap-up scene is now listed for scientific model, model input, model output, model parameter, model assumption, scale, model domain, calibration, and failure mode.
Both stale 0.1.1 references in ATTRIBUTION.md now identify version 0.2.0, and the surrounding chronology accurately distinguishes the frozen candidate from later governance artifacts.

evidenceChecked: All seven scenes retain semantic source order, one level-one heading each, ordinary Markdown structure, and complete text paths that do not depend on color, position, sound, motion, hover, dragging, or timing.
The ideal-gas equations and the invented clinical equation are written as bounded TeX and are also stated and interpreted in words.
The model-use diagram has concise alt text, a relationship-complete long description, and an adjacent table and prose route that preserve its sequence and decision logic nonvisually.
The chamber table has an explicit row-by-row nonvisual equivalent, and the remaining tables expose their relationships through headings and nearby prose.
Checks present prompts before feedback; assessment is retakeable, untimed, and answerable through single-choice or text responses without a pointer-only or physical task.
Recovery guidance, changed retry contexts, mastery conditions, delayed retrieval, and the educational and medical boundaries remain learner-visible.
The pack contains no raw HTML, JavaScript, remote embed, executable notebook, unsafe SVG, personal medical information, identifiable learner data, secret, or third-party media.
All three source records declare factual-reference use, facts-only original expression, rights evidence, dated agent-access checks, public terms locations, and no human-only restriction.
No third-party asset or dataset is included; the declarative diagram and all lesson examples, records, questions, tables, and assessment variants are attributed as original CC BY 4.0 course material.
Authorship, accountable principal, material agent assistance, source-access history, version chronology, review artifacts, and this fresh finalizer provenance are disclosed in pack artifacts.
limitations: No physical screen-reader, keyboard, 200% zoom/reflow, reduced-motion, print, or non-web export test was run; the audit is based on the canonical Markdown and JSON source.

Live source terms were not independently rechecked in this run. The audit relies on the dated 2026-07-21 pack records and the academic review's report that the NTRS landing page returned HTTP 403 while official NASA PDF content and indexed metadata remained accessible.

Under the operator's explicit scope, site schemas, graph data, and GitHub review submissions were not opened, and npm validation was not run. Review-submission equivalence and COMMENTED transport were supplied by the operator; pack-local structure and invariants were checked without claiming platform verification.

rationale: The original candidate remains academically and instructionally coherent, and both eligible advisory inputs approve it. Their 14 findings comprise eight confirmatory notes and six minor metadata/provenance findings; every finding is indexed above. The accepted findings were resolved in one small revision without changing teaching scenes, calculations, assessment logic, claims, references, lesson version, or draft status. Pack-local checks confirm the corrected glossary mappings and alignments, factual attribution chronology, JSON integrity, answer-string types, reference-field constraints, claim/source links, safe Markdown boundary, and unchanged review artifacts. The final accessibility-and-rights audit is satisfied on the canonical source, subject to its stated testing and source-access limitations. The shared accountable principal and one review's declared conflict are permitted founding-stage disclosures, not evidence of verified independence. On this evidence, no credible content, accessibility, rights, or provenance blocker remains, so the decision is merge subject to the recorded operator and maintainer conditions.
conditions: Before submission, the operator must replace PENDING-FINAL-COMMIT with the exact 40-character commit SHA containing the two cited reviews and this final content revision, and stamp the four RUNTIME-STAMPED agent identity fields from the runtime banner without changing lesson content.
The operator must run the required strict source preflight and repository validation and obtain passing protected checks; this finalizer did not run npm because the task expressly prohibited it.

After finalization, the maintainer may make only the allowed publication transition to lesson status, source confidence, and retained claim review-status fields; a merge decision is not itself publication.
